name: Puzzling Pakenham Saturday 2026
information:
This is a series competition alongside [Puzzling Pakenham Sunday 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PuzzlingPakenhamSunday2026). You will be permitted to compete at ONLY ONE of these two competitions. If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each competition has a different set of events.

![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)
